scope.reviewed: The outer 898C..8A34 body is 168 bytes / 79 Thumb instructions. The replay covers four mode bytes, three enable values, two validation responses and two provider widths. It reproduces all 48 recorded call sequences, 32-byte contexts, return values, SP and stop-PC checks. Disassembly confirms the actual A9D4 call is followed by the provider clear/copy, geometry, size calculation, validation and conditional row-selection call. Zero sequence in the synthetic row buffer means this packet does not test checksum-selected rows.
